reports.title: Earnings Release and Supplemental Financial and Operating Information

guidance.heading: OUTLOOK AND GUIDANCE
section: CBL is increasing FFO, as adjusted, guidance for 2026 to the range of $7.34 - $7.44 per share. Management now anticipates same-center NOI for full-year 2026 in the range of 0.75% to 2.25%. Volusia Mall has been removed from the same-center pool, reflecting CBL's cooperation with the lender on a sale, foreclosure or conveyance of the property.
